research.claim: Oracle Fusion Payables predefined reports cover invoices, payments, Payables-to-Ledger Reconciliation, period close, prepayments, income tax/withholding, and netting; Payables Invoice Aging Report lists unpaid invoices by aging period
Receivables predefined reports include aging reports, customer statements, invoice register, and receipts register
Fixed Assets predefined reports include an Asset Register documenting assets, depreciation, and value over time
